name: Toma Sazuko
source:
Toma is appreciated by many people because he doesn't hesitate to help someone, no matter what the problems, he can always find a solution.
In addition to that, he excels in all materials and marts matiaux.
[spoiler]Before the death of his father Toma was a perfectly normal student, until his father eventually became violent. At that moment, Everything has changed, Toma wanting to protect her mother from his father has learned self-defense techniques and it's also set to spend everyday learning everything he can find under his hands.[/spoiler]
